content: I've started a conversation at https://discuss.python.org/t/109821/ about getting official WASI binaries for WASI for CPython. That's mostly going to be specific to CPython and the dev team, but it does mean deciding on what flags to compile with (which might make this a @Joel Dice question). Right now I have https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/3945eaf2fcd9cbc3f3061275bd29751c8b2e7d3b/Platforms/WASI/__main__.py#L222 .
This is what componentize-py uses, FWIW. The official CPython WASI binaries don't necessarily need to use the same flags, though.
It doesn't look like much is really set, so I think we are good there.
